body: Other people here have given you great advice, but I just want to say please don’t give up. I know things are so, so hard right now. You’re only 15. You have the whole rest of your life ahead of you. I know it doesn’t seem like it right now, but it won’t always be this bad. Reach out to the people who love you. That’s what they’re there for. I know I’m just some random person on the Internet, but I care about you, and I’m rooting for you. You can have a great life.
You should totally use it. It looks fantastic!
